scenes.vo: Can the next generation of DeFi go beyond predefined rules?
Decentralized Finance removed the intermediaries, and opened financial services to anyone. But one fundamental limitation remains.
Most smart contracts can only execute conditions that were defined in advance. And the real world? It's rarely that predictable.
Imagine a protocol that could evaluate not just numbers, but news articles, websites, and changing real-world conditions.
This is where AI and blockchain meet.
GenLayer is exploring Intelligent Contracts. Smart contracts that use AI models to evaluate complex conditions, and interact with the real world.
But different AI models can interpret the same information differently. So how does a decentralized network reach agreement, without a single authority?
GenLayer's answer is Optimistic Democracy. A consensus mechanism built on validator evaluations, and a process for resolving disagreements.
Why does this matter for DeFi? Apps that interpret unstructured information, and respond to real-world events, in entirely new ways.
Of course, challenges remain. Security. Data reliability. Execution costs. And the unpredictability of AI.
But the future of DeFi might not be limited to predefined rules. And GenLayer is one of the projects exploring that direction.
So, could AI-powered smart contracts unlock the next wave of DeFi? Or are the risks still too big? Tell us what you think.
